children: Trio-Tech reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $62.6 million, up 72% year-over-year, driven by strong demand in its Semiconductor Back-End Solutions business. The company recorded a gross profit of $10.4 million (17% margin) and a small net loss attributable to common shareholders of $34,000 for the year ended June 30, 2026. Trio-Tech exited the year with total backlog of $24.2 million and expanded manufacturing capacity in Malaysia to support anticipated fiscal 2027 growth.
Total revenue for fiscal 2026: $62.6 million, a 72% increase from $36.5 million in fiscal 2025.
Semiconductor Back-End Solutions revenue: $49.0 million for fiscal 2026, up 99% year-over-year.
Gross profit for fiscal 2026: $10.4 million, representing a 17% gross margin (compared with $9.1 million and 25% margin in fiscal 2025).
Operating loss for fiscal 2026: $204,000 (compared with operating income of $254,000 in fiscal 2025).
Net loss attributable to common shareholders for fiscal 2026: $34,000; basic and diluted net loss per share: $0.00.
Backlog more than doubled year-over-year to $24.2 million at June 30, 2026, with SBS comprising approximately $19.8 million and Industrial Electronics approximately $4.4 million.

Demand driven by semiconductor reliability testing, including AI-related chip testing, and broadened semiconductor opportunities across automotive (EV and autonomous), high-performance computing and industrial electronics.

Secured a three-year production burn-in contract with a new global IDM and a separate three-year production burn-in contract with a second European EV semiconductor customer (minimum billings of ~$4.7 million; potential to scale to $6.0 million).

Expanded Malaysian footprint with ~104,000 sq. ft. additional space in Perai, Penang, enabling phased installation of system-level and electrical test capabilities and anticipated progressive volume increases beginning Q2 fiscal 2027.

Industrial Electronics bookings for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 to date total approximately $4.6 million, reflecting activity across aerospace, display solutions and other industrial markets; pursuing new market opportunities including data center and industrial energy-efficiency applications.

title: Trio-Tech Reports 72% FY2026 Revenue Growth to $62.6M, Backlog Doubles to $24.2M
